datePolicy: All 25 prose URLs have an explicit original access/attempt record dated 2026-11-05 in the inspected sources.md. This is not fresh localization access or a successful-fetch claim. evidenceStatus preserves direct, indexed, blocked, secondary and provisional limits. Titles are descriptive labels from the inspected source key/ledger, not newly verified page-title metadata. Hotel display dates, fare-effective dates and the future-at-research Cistern implementation date are not access dates.
uncertainties: No September 2027 hotel price or availability was established: requested dates were replaced by November defaults. EUR 110/night and EUR 440 total are independent planning targets, not quotes.
TRY 1,950 Cistern daytime ticket is an older municipal-era relay, not new-operator-confirmed. New hours notice effective 2026-11-15 was still future at research; old late-night advice is not used.

No exact ordinary Sunday Uskudar–Cengelkoy outward/return pairing or stop-call pattern was verified. Ferry excursion remains conditional, with bus/rail alternatives only if operating; tours are not substituted.

Marmaray bands, initial debit and anonymous-card refunds, M11 fare/operating window and official route-specific ferry tariff cells are unverified. Secondary ferry figures and budget allowances must not become published tariffs.

EUR 1 = TRY 50 is an assumed planning conversion, not live FX or a forecast. Hotel, food, transit, queues, walking, airport buffers and contingency are estimates. Insurance, major shopping, taxis and additional paid sights are not separately priced in the core.

Entry guidance is dated, German-nationality-specific information, not legal/immigration advice or guaranteed admission. Recheck rules, airline/transit requirements and safety advice before departure; recommend valid documents rather than expiry exceptions.

No flight times, actual room, hammam appointment, weather, prayer times or September 2027 service availability are confirmed. No booking, signup, contact, purchase or fresh external verification occurred during localization.
editingContract: Readable English and Simplified Chinese have matching numeric/date/currency/URL literals per corresponding line and table cell. Local drafts only; original run read-only, no new stars or Review markup, no shared build/registry edits.
